//! Generates an old-format backup fixture with a pinned iwcore version.
//! Usage: g <iwcore-version> <out-dir>
use iwcore::{BackupManager, Wallet};
use std::path::Path;

const PASSWORD: &str = "Fixture-Pass-2026!";

fn value_for(field_type: &str, value_type: &str) -> String {
    match field_type {
        "2FAC" => "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP".into(),
        "WIFI" => "WIFI:T:WPA;S:Fixture Net;P:wifi-pass-1;H:false;;".into(),
        "LINK" => "https://login.example.com/path?x=1".into(),
        "MAIL" => "fixture.user@example.com".into(),
        "USER" => "fixture_user".into(),
        "PHON" => "+41 44 123 45 67".into(),
        "DATE" | "EXPD" => "20290630".into(),
        "TIME" => "1230".into(),
        "CARD" => "4111111111111111".into(),
        "NOTE" => format!("Line 1\nZürich – 東京 – 🔐\n{}", "long ".repeat(400)),
        _ => match value_type {
            "pass" => format!("secret-{}-Ω", field_type.to_lowercase()),
            _ => format!("value of {field_type} – ñ"),
        },
    }
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let version = &args[1];
    let out = Path::new(&args[2]);
    let wallet_dir = out.join("wallet");
    let backup_dir = out.join("backups");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&wallet_dir).unwrap();
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&backup_dir).unwrap();

    let mut w = Wallet::create(&wallet_dir, PASSWORD, "en").unwrap();
    if !w.is_unlocked() {
        assert!(w.unlock(PASSWORD).unwrap());
    }

    let custom = w.add_label("Fixture Custom", "label", "text").unwrap();
    let folder = w.add_item("Fixture Folder", "folder", true, None).unwrap();
    let sub = w.add_item("Nested – Ünterordner", "folder", true, Some(&folder)).unwrap();

    // One item per system label, carrying every type that version knows.
    let all = w.add_item("Every field type", "document", false, Some(&sub)).unwrap();
    let labels = w.get_labels().unwrap();
    for (i, l) in labels.iter().enumerate() {
        let v = value_for(&l.field_type, &l.value_type);
        w.add_field(&all, &l.field_type, &v, Some(i as i32)).unwrap();
    }

    let login = w.add_item("Example Login", "web", false, Some(&folder)).unwrap();
    w.add_field(&login, "USER", "fixture_user", Some(0)).unwrap();
    w.add_field(&login, "PASS", "P@ss;word,with:special\"chars\\", Some(1)).unwrap();
    w.add_field(&login, "LINK", "https://login.example.com/", Some(2)).unwrap();
    w.add_field(&login, &custom, "custom label value", Some(3)).unwrap();

    let root_item = w.add_item("Root level item", "document", false, None).unwrap();
    w.add_field(&root_item, "NOTE", "", Some(0)).unwrap();

    let trashed = w.add_item("Trashed item", "document", false, None).unwrap();
    w.add_field(&trashed, "PASS", "trashed-secret", Some(0)).unwrap();
    w.delete_item(&trashed).unwrap();

    #[cfg(feature = "autofill")]
    let af = {
        use iwcore::autofill::{generate_keys, journal, IndexOptions, PendingOp, PendingRecord};
        let keys = generate_keys().unwrap();
        let index = w
            .build_autofill_index(&keys.index_key, 1, 1_790_000_000, IndexOptions::default())
            .unwrap();
        let rec = PendingRecord {
            record_id: "fixture-record-1".into(),
            op: PendingOp::Create,
            item_id: None,
            title: "Staged before update".into(),
            url: "https://staged.example.org".into(),
            identity_value: "staged@example.org".into(),
            identity_hint: None,
            password: "staged-pass-1".into(),
            totp_secret: None,
            created_at: 1_790_000_100,
        };
        let jr = journal::seal_record(&rec, &keys.journal_public, &keys.index_key).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(out.join("autofill-index-v1.bin"), &index).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(out.join("autofill-journal-v1.bin"), &jr).unwrap();
        serde_json::json!({
            "index_key": hex(&keys.index_key[..]),
            "journal_secret": hex(&keys.journal_secret[..]),
            "journal_public": hex(&keys.journal_public),
            "staged_record": rec,
        })
    };
    #[cfg(not(feature = "autofill"))]
    let af = serde_json::Value::Null;

    let items: Vec<_> = w.get_items().unwrap().to_vec();
    let fields: Vec<_> = w.get_fields().unwrap().to_vec();
    let backup = BackupManager::new(&backup_dir)
        .create_backup(w.database().unwrap(), true)
        .unwrap();

    let manifest = serde_json::json!({
        "generated_with_iwcore": version,
        "password": PASSWORD,
        "backup_file": backup.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy(),
        "trashed_item_id": trashed,
        "custom_label": custom,
        "labels": labels,
        "items": items,
        "fields": fields,
        "autofill": af,
    });
    std::fs::write(out.join("manifest.json"), serde_json::to_string_pretty(&manifest).unwrap()).unwrap();
    w.close();
    println!("{version}: {}", backup.display());
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
fn hex(b: &[u8]) -> String {
    b.iter().map(|x| format!("{x:02x}")).collect()
}
